_comment: CURATED pet reference (BASIC v1 — economy numbers are provisional, double-check vs RealmEye later). KEY: feeding an item costs Fame set by the pet's RARITY (same cost regardless of which item); the item's FEED POWER is what actually levels the abilities, so feed HIGH feed-power items to get the most growth per fame.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.desc: Restores HP over time — your core survivability. Aim for this as ability 1.

abilities.name: Magic Heal
abilities.desc: Restores MP — lets casters spam spells, Knights chain-stun, Rogues stay cloaked. Aim for ability 2.

abilities.name: Electric
abilities.desc: Paralyzes + damages nearby enemies. Strong 3rd ability (can nudge boss positioning, though).

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.desc: Pulls enemy shots/aggro for a moment — situational alternative 3rd.

abilities.name: Attack / Savage
abilities.desc: Negligible flat damage — skip it; it wastes a slot that could be Heal/MHeal/Electric.

feeding: Feeding an item costs Fame set by the pet's RARITY (above) — the SAME cost no matter which item you feed.
The item's FEED POWER (shown in its tooltip) is what actually levels the abilities, so feed HIGH feed-power items — you don't want to spend the same fame on a low-FP item.
Feed Power applies in FULL to every unlocked ability; spare UT/ST whites you don't need are the best fodder.
fusing: Fuse two pets of the SAME family and SAME rarity to upgrade rarity (Common→…→Divine).
Max the 1st ability before fusing — the new pet's level cap = the average of the two pets' 1st-ability levels + 20 (+10 when fusing Legendary → Divine).
Best practice: max ALL abilities on both pets before fusing, for the highest possible result.
